## Checklist

- [ ] My mod is in its own folder, `mods/<my-mod-name>/`, with `msm.project.json`, `content/` and `assets/` copied from my project.
- [ ] The folder has a `README.md` from the template, a `picture.png` and a `LICENSE` (or I accept CC BY 4.0, the default).
- [ ] Every picture and sound is my own, or shared under a licence that allows it and credited in my README. Nothing is copied from Minecraft.
- [ ] The mod does nothing to harm players or their worlds.
- [ ] The project has no errors in MCSuperMods (Things to fix or the Problems tab).
- [ ] I added a line for my mod to the table in `mods/README.md`.
- [ ] I agree that my mod is shared under the licence in its folder.

<!-- The "Check mods" check runs by itself. If it fails, click Details: it says what to fix. -->
